description: The tasks that the tutorials cover: the frequent tasks of each profile of Aura's docs/screen-map.md (Users and Frequent Tasks), and the basics that every task needs. A tutorial names the tasks that it shows in its covers; scripts/tutorials.sh coverage lists the tasks without one. The status of a task says how much of it the pinned Aura can show: available, partial (the notes say what is missing), or not-in-aura; scripts and the aura-bump skill update it with each version of Aura.

tasks.task: Sign in to Sentinel Aura, and land on the Ticket list
Open a Ticket from the Ticket list, and read its Overview
See their own profile, manage their own API keys, and review the identity events of their own account
tasks.notes: Account has no screen document yet.

tasks.task: Find the other users in the directory, with the Tickets assigned to them and those of their packages
tasks.notes: Users has no screen document yet.

tasks.task: Work the queue of new Tickets: take them, or ignore them, or mark them as duplicates
tasks.notes: The New view lists the queue; taking, ignoring, and marking duplicates are not in Aura yet.

tasks.task: Analyze the packages, tracks, and Product eligibility of their Tickets
tasks.notes: The package tree and the affected versions show on the Ticket; changing tracks and eligibility is not in Aura yet.

tasks.task: Maintain the references of a Ticket: add, edit, and delete them
Maintain severities, SUSE CVSS assessments, and priority overrides
tasks.notes: The Ticket shows them, and the explanation of a priority; changing them is not in Aura yet.

tasks.task: Follow the deadlines of their Tickets, and see which deliveries are late
Manage the confidentiality of embargoed Tickets, their Coordinated Release Dates, and their access grants
tasks.notes: Access grants are granted and revoked on the Ticket; the Coordinated Release Date and confidentiality are not editable yet.

tasks.task: Create Tickets manually and refetch CVE data
tasks.notes: Refetch is on the Ticket, but the example dataset disables every fetcher, so it never shows; creating a Ticket is not in Aura yet.

tasks.task: Check their pending fixes and their submission deadlines
tasks.notes: My packages has no screen document yet.

tasks.task: Follow their deliveries in progress, with their submission and release requests
tasks.notes: My packages has no screen document yet.

tasks.task: Open a Ticket that an analyst shares, and find in its package tree the tracks that wait for their submission
Search for a CVE, a Ticket, or a package
See SUSE's status for a CVE: its Ticket, the affected Products and codestreams, and whether the fix is released
Open the links that colleagues share
Manage users: create local users, assign roles, unlock accounts, reset passwords, and deactivate and reactivate users
tasks.notes: Users has no screen document yet.

tasks.task: Review and revoke the API keys of every user, and review the identity audit log
tasks.notes: Administration has no screen document yet.

tasks.task: Operate the fetchers: trigger, enable, disable, and configure them
tasks.notes: Fetchers has no screen document yet.

tasks.task: Work the non-confidential Tickets as vulnerability analysts do, without access to embargoed data
tasks.notes: As for the analysts' tasks: the Ticket list and the Ticket show the work; most of its actions are not in Aura yet.

tasks.task: Create and rotate the API keys of bot accounts
tasks.notes: Account has no screen document yet.

tasks.task: Reconstruct who changed what on a Ticket, and what Sentinel did by itself, from its audit log
